review_request.title: Add npm global installer for GCW
review_request.summary: Adds the @fzf-labs/gcw npm CLI with gcw init, gcw doctor, template packaging, tests, and docs.

risks: Moderate: packaging copies many repo-local GCW assets, and the package is marked UNLICENSED until maintainers decide the repository license.
scope: Adds npm package metadata, a Node CLI wrapper, template build script, CLI tests, npm build output ignore rules, documentation updates, and Issue #19 GCW evidence.
reviewer_notes: Focus review on template asset boundaries, default non-overwrite behavior, optional GitHub Actions installation, and package metadata/license expectations.
